thesis: AI growth and cash generation are strong but earnings-basis discrepancies prevent adjudicating the valuation. Neither establishes a reliable forward-return denominator.
strongest_counterexample: AI semiconductor revenue rose 221% and FCF exceeds profit, offering unusually tangible growth evidence.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of negative AI semiconductor revenue growth.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of positive normalized EPS and FCF growth after valuation-basis reconciliation.
evidence_gaps: Acquisition accounting and comparable dated EPS estimates.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: AI revenue growth and strong cash generation substantiate demand
Strong AI sales and free cash flow make the operating case credible
